Name: Creaturebook - Bestiary Framework
Author: KeDili
Description:
Creaturebook is a framework that allows content packs to add their creatures to the mod's 'bestiary', and allows the farmer to discover these creatures via clicking to NPCs with the mod's custom notebook item in hand.

For all content pack documentation, source code, credits, permissions and translations, see the mod's GitHub repository.
Which is [url=https://github.com/KediDili/Creaturebook#readme]linked[/url]﻿ here.
To find the content pack that added these moths in preview images, check Requirements section. You will find other content packs (if any are made :sweat_smile:)

[b][color=#00ffff][size=6]= Config options explanation here[/size][/color][/b]
[b]
[/b][color=#f1c232][size=4][b]- 'OpenMenuKeybind'[/b]
[/size][/color][size=3][color=#f4f4f4] ﻿Determines via which keybind will you open the mod's bestiary menu. Default value is [b]'LeftShift + LeftControl + B'[/b][/color][/size][color=#f1c232][size=4]
[b]
- 'WayToGetNotebook'[/b]
[/size][/color][size=3][color=#f4f4f4] ﻿Determines how you want your Creaturebook item to be given. Valid values are '[b]Letter[/b]', '[b]Inventory[/b]' and '[b]Events[/b]'.
﻿- [b]Events[/b]: Gets you to obtain it via events.[/color]
[/size]﻿ ﻿[size=3]- [b]Letter[/b]: Gets you to obtain it via mail.[/size][size=3]
﻿﻿- [b]Inventory[/b]: Directly spawns it into your inventory

[color=#f1c232][size=4][b]- 'ShowScientificNames'[/b]
[/size][/color][size=3][color=#f4f4f4] ﻿Determines if you want the menu to display creatures' scientific names when they're discovered.
﻿Valid values are '[b]true[/b]' and '[b]false[/b]'. ﻿
﻿﻿- [b]true[/b]: Enables scientific names[/color]
[/size]﻿ ﻿[size=3]- [b]false[/b]: Disables scientific names[/size][/size]

[color=#f1c232][size=4][b]- 'ShowDiscoveryDates'[/b]
[/size][/color][size=3][color=#f4f4f4] ﻿Determines if you want the menu to display dates when creatures are discovered, once they're discovered.
[/color][/size][size=3][color=#f4f4f4]Valid values are '[b]true[/b]' and '[b]false[/b]'. ﻿
﻿﻿- [b]true[/b]: Enables displaying dates[/color]
[/size]﻿ ﻿[size=3]- [b]false[/b]: Disables displaying dates[/size]

[color=#f1c232][b][size=4]-[/size] [size=4]Information & [/size][size=4]Mod Usage [/size][/b][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3][b]What even is this... 'Creaturebook'?[/b]
﻿﻿Creaturebook is a framework mod that allows content packs to add their creatures' pages for information, and allows said ﻿ ﻿creatures to be ﻿﻿discovered by the player. So yeah, it's sort of a bestiary mod. Since the mod is a framework, don't expect it to do ﻿﻿so much without content packs. ﻿View mod images to see how does a player discover a creature and see info about it.

﻿[b]How do I obtain Creaturebook item?
[/b] ﻿That depends on what your `WayToGetNotebookItem` config is set to. It's valid values are `Letter`, `Inventory` and `Events`.
﻿See config ﻿values section above.

﻿[b]How do I discover a creature?[/b]
[b] ﻿﻿[/b]There are three ways:
﻿1) One is via clicking a tile (with the Creaturebook item in hand) that's set to get you to discover a creature ﻿instantly (Note that ﻿ ﻿this feature is completely untested).
﻿2) The primary way is clicking to anything that has got a page ﻿in Creaturebook and that's coded ﻿into the game as an NPC ﻿(So yes, using Custom Companions will work, fellow authors.) with ﻿﻿Creaturebook item in hand.
﻿3) The third is attaching an item

﻿[b]How do I see information about creatures?[/b]
﻿First, you need to have discovered what creature you want to see. If you already have, use the mod's menu opening keybind ﻿ ﻿while no other menu ﻿is open. You can find it in your config.json, or install Generic Mod Config Menu to easily change it.
﻿The default keybind is [b]`LeftControl + LeftShift + B`[/b].
﻿
﻿[b]There's this button on the mod's menu at the right side of this right arrow button, what is it?[/b][/size][/color][b]
[/b] ﻿﻿[size=3]It's a button to open the menu's search box. Type one of a creature's ID, translated name or scientific name, press enter and the ﻿﻿correct page ﻿﻿﻿shall show up. View mod images to visually see how is it used.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232][size=4]-[/size][size=4] Installation [/size][/color][/b]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3][b]How to install?[/b]
[/size] [size=3]Just like any other mod. Drop into anywhere in Mods folder.[/size]

[size=3][b]Dependencies
﻿[/b]﻿The only necessary requirements are SMAPI and SpaceCore. Content Patcher and Generic Mod Config Menu are optional ﻿dependencies.﻿[/size][/color]

[b] ﻿Is reporting bugs okay?[/b]

[/size] [size=3][b]﻿Is giving suggestions okay?[/b]
